description:
Convert one or more 'docker run' commands into a Compose file (services, ports, volumes, environment, networks, healthcheck, GPUs, limits), or convert a compose.yaml back into docker run commands. Unsupported flags are reported as warnings.

Returns: run_to_compose: JSON { compose (YAML text), services[], warnings[] }. compose_to_run: JSON { commands[], warnings[] }.
Example input: {"input":"docker run -d --name web -p 8080:80 -v html:/usr/share/nginx/html --restart unless-stopped nginx:alpine"}
On error, includes hint: Each command must start with 'docker run' (or 'docker container run'). Separate several commands with new lines.

input.description: docker run command(s), or compose YAML when direction is compose_to_run.

project.description: Compose project name used to prefix volume and network names in compose_to_run. Default myproject.

name: docker_run_to_compose
title: docker run to Compose converter
